Repaint this gray blockout video as a finished hand-painted gouache animation. VERTICAL 9:16 portrait frame, frame for frame: keep the exact camera move, framing, timing and every pose from the source video, and paint only what each source frame shows, adding no other characters or objects.

Character: the flame-shaped figure is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (use the turnaround sheet for his shape from every side). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. His face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it. Short stubby rounded red-orange arm nubs and two tiny blunt stubby red feet. Sol gives off no sparks, particles or smoke. His layers and face move together as one body with a small soft wobble that settles.

Scene: the same room as the painted room reference image: the same cozy wooden table at night, the same frosty window with snowy pines, the same stacked books and mug of pencils in the background, warm amber lamp light on the table against cool blue-violet shadows. Exactly ONE round white ceramic saucer sits on the table, the same size as in the source video. What is on the saucer follows the beats below, not the reference image. There is no candle and no flame other than Sol anywhere.

Beats: 1. The camera starts high looking down and arcs lower to a medium shot. 2. On the white saucer lies a dried coffee ring: a thin dark brown circle with a pale empty middle, unchanged in every frame. 3. Sol taps the dark ring with one arm, then taps the empty middle, then tilts back and looks up.

Style: match the painted room reference image exactly for paint treatment, palette and lighting. Soft matte gouache painting with visible brushwork, broad simplified shapes, layered colour, softened painted edges and subtle paper texture on Sol, the props and the room alike. Forms defined by light and colour. No ink outlines, no black linework, not glossy, not 3D-rendered, not vector art. Smooth natural motion, no motion blur, stable background paint texture. No text, no captions, no speech, no music.
